name: Tori 11 · Travel · notify
description: Every travel WhatsApp message: reads what may be shared (travel_notification), renders the text, sends it (text, buttons, or the approved template outside the 24-hour window) and logs the result.

parameters.query: SELECT public.travel_notification($1::uuid, nullif($2, '')::uuid) AS n, $1 AS user_id, $2 AS match_id, $3 AS kind, $4 AS text;
SELECT public.travel_log($1, nullif($2, '')::uuid, NULL, nullif($3, '')::uuid, $4::jsonb) AS logged;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $json.statusCode === 200 ? 'travel.notification.sent' : 'travel.notification.failed', $('Render message').item.json.user_id, $('Render message').item.json.match_id || '', JSON.stringify({ kind: $('Render message').item.json.kind, http_status: $json.statusCode ?? null, error_code: $json.body?.error?.code ?? $json.error?.code ?? null }) ] }}

parameters.query: SELECT public.travel_log('travel.notification.skipped', nullif($1, '')::uuid, NULL, nullif($2, '')::uuid, $3::jsonb) AS logged;
